extraContent.title: Gauge and Combo Mechanics
content: A resource required to use <tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/revolving-cannon.png} tip={Revolving Cannon (1st Job)}> Revolving Cannon (1st Job), <tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/detonate.png} tip={Detonate (1st Job)}> Detonate (1st Job), and <tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/magnum-cannon.png} tip={Magnum Cannon (3rd Job)}> Magnum Cannon (3rd Job). Once your Ammo resource is depleted, you will need to reload which is done automatically when your Ammo is empty

This resource is exclusively used to activate <tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/bunker-buster-explosion.png} tip={Bunker Buster Explosion (1st Job)}> Bunker Buster Explosion. You gain one Dynamo Gauge bar whenever you use <tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/revolving-cannon.png} tip={Revolving Cannon (1st Job)}> Revolving Cannon. Once <tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/bunker-buster-explosion.png} tip={Bunker Buster Explosion (1st Job)}> is used, you enter an Overheat state where your gauge is set to max but you cannot charge the Dynamo Gauge or use <tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/bunker-buster-explosion.png} tip={Bunker Buster Explosion (1st Job)}>

Skills with a 'C' on the Skill Icon are Charge Skills. These skills can be held and charged while using other skills. When fully charged, releasing these Charge Skills while using other skills will cancel that skill and instead activate the Charge Skill and create an additional shockwave attack. This is used for Animation Canceling. Below are the following Charge Skills:

<bp_<tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/bobbing.png} tip={Bobbing (2nd Job)}> Bobbing [2nd Job]_<tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/weaving.png} tip={Weaving (3rd Job)}> Weaving [3rd Job]_<tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/hammer-smash.png} tip={Hammer Smash (3rd Job)}> Hammer Smash [3rd Job]_<tt src={/class-icons/resistance/blaster/hyper-magnum-punch.png} tip={Hyper Magnum Punch (Hyper Skill)}> Hyper Magnum Punch [Hyper Skill]_>

meta: Blaster is a STR warrior class part of the Resistance class group. Blasters are known to be high-APM compared to other classes and have a big learning curve. Additionally, Blasters have two additional types of resources, Ammo and a Dynamo Gauge. Certain skills will consume Ammo to use and charge up your Dynamo Gauge to unleash powerful attacks
